gloss: to teach, to tell, to inform

definitions.explanation: Used when imparting knowledge or skills to someone. The person being taught is marked with に.
Used when sharing information like phone numbers, addresses, or directions with someone.

examples.japanese: {田中|たなか}{先生|せんせい}は{数学|すうがく}を{教|おし}えています。
{電話番号|でんわばんごう}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me your phone number.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}を{教|おし}えてもらいました。
examples.english: I had someone teach me Japanese.
examples.notes: Receiving the favor of being taught

notes: An ichidan verb. The counterpart is {習|なら}う (narau, to learn). Common pattern: [person]に[subject]を{教|おし}える.
